address: Khasra No./ Plot No.3/GH/01 , SECTOR-3, VIDHYADHAR NAGAR SCHEME , Jaipur - 302023 (Rajasthan)
remark: Since the property situated at 3/GH/01,Sector-3,Vidhyadhar Nagar Scheme,Jaipur,on which the promoter is planning to develop & construct the project "Jaypore",was auctioned in favour of the promoter by JDA &as per Pt. 11 of Auction Terms&Conditions of said property,the promoter was not required to get the maps approved before starting the construction on the said property & was required to submit an Affidavit in this regard to the concerned authorities.The Promoter had duly complied with the conditions mentioned in the Pt 11 of Auction Terms&Conditions of said property & related documents were duly uploaded at the RERA portal while applying for the RERA registration of the said Project.Though,the promoter was not required to get the maps approved as per pt 11 of Auction Terms & Conditions but still the promoter had applied for the maps approval to the concerned authorities & got the approval & released maps via BPC Letter No. ज.वि.र्पा/स.स/बी.पी.सी(बी.पी.)/2017/डी-2021 dtd 15.09.2017,copy of which has been duly updated & uploaded under head "Project Approval Document" of "Documents Tab". Based on Pt. No. 5 of Circular No. क्रमांक प.18(25) नविवि/सामान्य/2014 dated 27.06.2017 issued by Urban Development & Housing Department(Copy attached under “Project Approval Document" of "Documents Tab") regarding Fire NOC, at the construction stage, instead of submitting Fire NOC, the promoter is only required to submit an Affidavit in this regard(Copy attached under Project Approval Document" of "Documents Tab"). However, the promoter has applied for Fire NOC, the application of which is also attached under “Documents” tab.With regard to EC,as per notification dtd 14.09.2006 & 09.12.2016 respectively issued by Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change,the projects having built up area of less than 20,000 sq. mtrs are not required to obtain EC & since the B.U.A of our project is less than 20,000 sq. mtrs.,therefore,the requirement for EC is not applicable on said property.

costDetail.n: For the purposes of sub-clause (D) of clause (I) of sub-section (2) of section 4, the land cost shall be the cost incurred by the promoter whether as an outright purchase, lease charges etc.
Revenue or area share given to land owner in lieu of land under any kind of agreement such as Joint Venture, Joint Development etc, in case the Promoter is not the owner of the land.
Amount paid to land owner. (Method of land valuation)
Incidental costs related to acquisition of land such as stamp duty, brokerage, settlement costs of litigation, premiums paid to government authorities related to land.
Interest on finance for purchase of land.
Litigation costs incurred for land acquisition.
Property and other taxes, fees, premiums paid.
Estimated Cost of Construction as certified by Engineer

For the purposes of sub-clause (D) of clause (I) of sub - section (2) of section 4, the construction cost shall be the total cost incurred by the promoter, towards the on - site expenditure for the physical development of the project and includes fees payable to the architects, consultants, project managers / staff including engineers, marketing agents etc. fees / charges / security deposit payable to various departments / authorities, Labor Cess, VAT which are incurred during the development of the project.

On-site expenditure for development of entire project excluding cost of construction as per (ii) above, i.e. 
salaries, consultants fees, site overheads, cost of services (including water, electricity, sewerage), cost of 
machineries and equipment including its hire and maintenance costs, consumables etc. All costs directly 
incurred to complete the construction of the buildings /wings of the project registered
Payment of Taxes, cess, fees, charges, Approval cost for Construction etc. premiums, interest etc. to any statutory Authority
Interest payable to financial institutions, scheduled banks, non-banking financial institution (NBFC) or money lenders on construction funding or money borrowed for construction & Project
